items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And I called it from another fellow named Julius.

ctx.x: Well, I asked him about, did anybody take a hot chorus and play chords? Or did they always pick it?

He said, did anybody take a hot chorus and play it with chords or pick, pick it? I was the first one that took that hot chorus. Was picking or? Wrapping. Wrapping. Yeah. Wrapping. You know, Eddie, not by myself, the whole band stopped. And just the kick-toe and the bass would take a hot. Oh yeah. But now, every man in the band takes a hot, you see. You see, I had a rap like that, you know. Oh yeah. Like that, you know. None of them couldn't catch that rap, but now they know it now, you see. I taught it over in…
He told me he liked that today. Yeah.
